# Story: STRY9000001
## Short Description
[Interface Mgmt]: Implement Scripted REST API endpoint for SAP IDOC ingestion
## Description
Created a Scripted REST API (/api/x_sap/idoc) with a Script Include that parses the XML payload, validates Basic Auth credentials, and maps IDoc segments to the u_vendor_invoice table. Includes unit tests with Postman collections.
## Work Notes
Dev - endpoint created, tested with Postman (200 OK).

# Story: STRY9000003
## Short Description
[Portal]: Fix intermittent password reset failures for SSO users
## Description
Users reported that the self-service password reset intermittently fails with a generic error. Root cause: a misconfigured retry in the IDP connector. The article explains how support agents can recognize the issue, check the connector status, and guide users through the workaround while the fix is deployed.
## Work Notes
Support - workaround validated with 3 affected users.

stories.note: Szándékos határeset (spec US1 AS2): üzleti folyamat-leírás fejlesztői részletekkel.

# Story: STRY9000002
## Short Description
Update the vendor invoice approval flow notification text
## Description
Adjusted the approval notification wording for finance users, and fixed the underlying Flow Designer action that queries the vendor table via GlideRecord. The notification template is user-facing; the flow change is technical.
## Work Notes
Dev - GlideRecord query fixed; BA - new wording approved by Finance.
